Chapter 7008: Excuse

Chapter 7008: Excuse

Golden Machine Immortal stopped the drilling. Although it was a fortress, everyone thought it was looking at the speaker.

“This is Dusk Realm, not your member’s home.” It spoke with disdain.

“That’s incorrect.” Amethyst was not afraid despite the fortress race being stronger than his alliance. This was a personal matter.

“This is Fantian Dynasty founded by Fellow Daoist Fantian. The dao in Dusk started with her and she is our good friend, we’re just visiting her home.” Mo Xiangsheng mustered all his courage to speak among the golden immortals.

Of course, he was still hiding behind Amethyst Immortal.

“Our race has chosen this place, go somewhere else.” The fortress only replied to Amethyst Immortal.

Amethyst contemplated for a second before answering: “There must be an incredible treasure down there. Is it the coveted source?”

He wanted more chaos, the only way he could have the tiniest chance of obtaining the celestial source.

“The celestial source?” Overlords and immortals clamored.

“That has nothing to do with you, everything here belongs to our race.” The fortress said.

“Our alliance was here first.” Amethyst said.

“That is irrelevant. Ladies and gentlemen, it is time to leave.” The fortress insisted.

“Your race has already obtained Heavenfall’s source. Aren’t you being too greedy now and inconsiderate now?” Amethyst smiled coldly.

“Too greedy indeed. We borrowed the pathway here and didn’t compete for Heavenfall’s source, but Dusk’s source is another matter.” An immortal agreed.

The crowd became agitated as they looked down at the ancestral ground.

The fortress was furious but couldn’t take the situation lightly. There were other golden immortals in the crowd.

“We came here prepared, please consider your next action carefully.” It uttered coldly.

“And? This is our member’s home. You should be the one leaving.” Amethyst used a hilarious justification.

Immortals never cared about these trivial matters and always did what they wanted. However, this was helpful in this situation as an excuse.

“We must take over this place.” The fortress spoke again.

“Then I will have to ask you to leave in the name of justice.” Amethyst said.

“Hahaha, immortals on the side of justice?” The fortress laughed.

“Today I am.” Amethyst sneered: “Don’t make me expel you.”

“Such a shameless immortal coming up with an excuse, losing all face. Is it a fight you want?” The fortress spoke.

“Where is your face when you choose to rob this place? Wait, you don’t have a face anyway.” Amethyst retorted.

“Hahaha.” The crowd started laughing.

“So be it, we’ll do it your way.” The annoyed fortress decided.
